title: July 4th
summary: Are you busy or have other plans for our Nation's 250th birthday on July 4th, 2026? We are looking to see if there is any interest in having a 4th of July picnic at the North Clubhouse. In addition, we are looking at the time of day to hold, whether for the lunch time or dinner time. Upon approval the recreation clubs will provide the hot dogs, hamburgers and rolls.
